top_signals.title: EU’s Proposed Shipping Subsidies Could Make BioLNG Cheaper Than Fuel Oil
top_signals.summary: Europe’s carbon market could soon start paying shipowners to switch fuels, but the support on offer is far from equal. In July, the European Commission proposed a revision of the European Union’s Emissions Trading System that would reserve up to 110 million allowances between 2028 and 2040 for a new Sustainable Maritime Alternative Propulsion (SMAP) mechanism, which is meant to cover part of the price gap between fossil marine fuels and sustainable alternatives. top_signals.title: Brazil Hedging Costs Spike as Election Anxiety Surges
top_signals.summary: Investor jitters are kicking in ahead of Brazil’s presidential election runoff, sending the cost of hedging surging.
